name: Hombetsu (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Hombetsu town emblem in white: two broken concentric rings enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Hombetsu, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 9 November 1931.

features.role: Hombetsu town emblem — two broken concentric rings enclosing a stylised character
